claims: Pragmata releases worldwide on April 17, 2026, for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, PC via Steam, and Nintendo Switch 2.
Pragmata is a sci-fi action-adventure game.
Pragmata features a "regional rolling midnight launch" for consoles.
The Nintendo Switch 2 version of Pragmata in Japan/Asia releases on April 24, 2026.
Pragmata launches at 9 PM PDT on April 16 for west coast North America.
Pragmata launches at 12 a.m. EDT on April 17 for the east coast.
Pragmata follows the characters Hugh and Diana.
Pragmata is set in a sci-fi, lunar-based setting.
